report.headline: Arabic landing page live; ad budgets rebalanced; IVR and tracking fixes underway

done.text: Built and published the Arabic car-accident landing page (maadilaw.com/ar-car-accident-lawyer): full right-to-left layout, same form and call tracking as the English PPC pages, Arabic leads tagged separately in the CRM. Page is kept out of Google search so it only receives ad traffic.
Added new creative to the Arabic Instant Form campaign and paused one underperforming video ad.
Shifted $50/day from LSA to Google Ads (LSA now at $57/day); new Performance Max campaign is live at $10/day. LSA and Google Ads will both be monitored and adjusted as results come in.
Updated the phone menu so callers who don't press a key hear the menu twice (down from three times) before being connected to the new-client queue.
Re-enabled the Meta Lead ID capture workflow so incoming Instant Form leads write their ID to the reporting field in the CRM.

in_progress.text: Reviewing four CRM tracking gaps flagged in audit: opportunity source mapping, source-overwrite protection (LSA guard missing from one workflow), and Meta/Google conversion workflow rules — clarifications exchanged, fixes being confirmed.
Rebuilding the Clio-to-GHL contact sync through Zapier to fix source overwrites and blank contact data caused by the native plugin; existing GHL-to-Clio Zapier direction is unaffected.

Designing a lead-source dashboard in the CRM with date filters (7 / 30 / 90 days / 12 months), showing leads and signed cases by source including Meta drill-downs. Waiting on the Clio sync fix to land first.
Two video ads (English) queued for editing with B-roll cutaways provided; editing now in progress.

waiting_on_you.text: Please review the Arabic copy on the live landing page (maadilaw.com/ar-car-accident-lawyer) and either approve it or send us your preferred copy so we can swap it in before running any Arabic ads.
Please confirm who on your team handles Arabic calls on 708-274-4368 and during which hours, so we can start the Arabic keyword test with confidence that callers will be served in Arabic.

Please arrange a quick test of the updated phone menu: call (312) 312-7558 from an outside phone, do not press any keys, and confirm here that the menu plays twice and the call reaches the right person.
To complete the lead-source dashboard, we need owner-level access to your Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts so we can check whether ad spend data can be pulled into the CRM view.

next_week.text: Tighten keywords in the Google Search campaign to reduce wasted spend, and continue monitoring LSA vs. Google Ads budget split.
Once Arabic copy and intake coverage are confirmed, share the landing page URL with the ads team to launch the Arabic keyword test on Google Search.
Complete Clio-to-GHL Zapier rebuild, run an end-to-end test lead through the intake workflow, and post results.
Begin building the lead-source dashboard in the CRM once the Clio sync fix is confirmed live.
